brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to confirm Silk Factor's physical location and authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor release disposition. The 26 kg waiver's pending microbes, blank client acceptance and contradictory dates/release language remain unresolved in reviewed evidence; packing instructions do not prove release or shipments. Send internally: Aaron and Evelyn, please confirm both lots' locations and any shipments, reconcile Luke's acceptance, microbial results and waiver dates with Sam today, and record disposition before further release or fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Roon 3 PM visit and reported quality issues. Josh accepts later-week 150-per-scent shipment but reports runny texture, underfills and tight tubes, and requires consistent capper use and final packout. The 5 kg demonstration, later shipment and 10K run are distinct; released materials, cleaning and equipment readiness are unverified. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, before Josh's 3 PM visit, confirm the approved 5 kg scope, yesterday's lot codes, material and cleaning readiness, and a documented fill-weight, texture, capper and packout check before promising the later-week shipment.

ACT NOW 3: Lice Sisters water blocks remaining Nit Glue batches. Production explicitly requests 220 kg, about 60 US gallons, of suitable water to finish the order. The stated 400 kg total less 108 kg used and 75 kg remaining equals 217 kg; confirm the 220 kg request and approved water specification. Purchase and receipt are unverified; this is separate from the Repel preservative gate. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, confirm the 220 kg water requirement and approved specification today, check existing supply and orders, then send me the exact purchase request and needed-by time so we can authorize supply without duplicating an order.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk Factor's physical disposition first, then secure suitable water and a documented Roon go/no-go before the 3 PM visit.
